cohort: Women who underwent caesarean delivery or peripartum hysterectomy at Fatima Al-Zahraa Administrative hospital, from the 1st of January 2015 till the 30th of September 2018
finding: The incidence of bladder injury during caesarean delivery or peripartum hysterectomy was 0.19%, and risk factors included previous caesarean section, placenta accreta, uterine rupture and adhesions.
